svg.title: Approved time and payroll-period support for the register
svg.desc: Approved time and payroll-period support for the register. Approved time matches payroll by employee and period; labor allocations link through PayrollRegisterLine. PayrollPeriod identifies the register population. Keep the record grains separate. Foreign-key paths, analytical matches, and business context answer different questions; read the numbered evidence table before joining.
